purpose: Insert one explicit current-topology enumeration after a located mutation and before its stale-reference consumer.
trigger: Use when one consumer is proven to use a pre-mutation body/face/edge collection.

inputs.name: stale_reference_location
inputs.description: Source location and old reference/collection consumed after mutation.

inputs.name: topology_change_point
inputs.description: Single operation that changed topology and its output identity.

inputs.name: consumers
inputs.description: Downstream consumers; one repair target is required.

preconditions: One topology mutation and one stale consumer are causally located.
Target API exposes current enumeration for affected object type.

outputs.name: refresh_point
outputs.description: One copyable enumeration statement/insertion location after mutation.

outputs.name: refreshed_reference_binding
outputs.description: Old consumer binding replaced by current-topology binding.

outputs.name: needs_manual_review
outputs.description: True when mutation/consumer causality or API enumeration is unknown.

postconditions: The emitted refresh point enumerates after mutation; missing downstream selection bindings remain unresolved instead of introducing undefined helpers. Execution is not claimed.
Repair does not alter mutation or add unrelated selection.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21-compatible contract reasoning; no host execution is performed by this operation.
implementation.notes: The reusable artifact is this candidate guidance contract; no executable implementation is claimed. One refresh point only; not a topology repair workflow.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: The inserted point is the required post-mutation refresh; consumers must not reuse pre-mutation handles.

failure_modes.safe_state: Leave stale reference unchanged and stop.

recovery.action: Return needs_manual_review and request exact locations.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare operation_id with the EX/ER catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
validation.expected: Consumer reads a fresh reference after mutation.

evidence_level.notes: Guidance interface checked on host; synthetic independent application reviewed. No controller event or repaired geometry was observed for this guide.
